QuestInfo.name: Pupa's Request
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1093000##k is looking for you on Florina Beach.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1093000##k wants you to collect Coconuts so she can make coconut juice. Coconut juice is a Pirate-y drink, isn't it? Help her out by knocking coconuts out of the trees with your #rRegular Attack#k.
QuestInfo.2: #b#p1093000##k made you coconut juice with the coconuts you brought her.

0.0: Hello, hello! Why, you look so parched, friend! Wouldn't you like some of my premium organic Coconut Juice? It's made from coconuts right here in Florina Beach.
0.1: Well, see, the thing is...I'm kinda running out of coconuts. I really need someone to get me more...
0.2: I could really use some more #b#t04000136#s#k to make my famous juice. Would you help me out?

yes.0: Great! You can get #b#t04000136#s#k from Coconut Trees all over Florina Beach. When you find a tree, whack it with your #rRegular Attack#k to make it rain coconuts. Just #b#r5 of #t04000136#s##k should be enough.

no.0: Fine, but I'm gonna run out of #b#t02022258#s#k real soon...

1.0: Did the monsters near the trees not bother you? Wow...

yes.0: These #b#t04000136#s#k are perfect. Okay, l'll whip up some more #b#t02022258#s#k right now!
